A '''braised crimson fungus''' is the simple preparation of the [[Crimson Fungus|crimson fungus]], a secret [[ingredient]]. It heals {{Hp|2}} and gives {{EffectLink|Weakness}} for 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/braised_crimson_fungus.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe is secret and is never added to the recipe book.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 0.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|2}} and gives Weakness I for 0:30.

It has no crafting use. Cooking one grants ''Hidden Flavors''.
